notes: Synthetic: authored by hand, 2026-10-28; ai.google.dev and cloud.google.com were blocked, so field names and enums come from the machine-readable references named per case in case.json notes. Values (ids, signatures, token counts, vectors, audio, text) are invented. Model: gemini-3.8-flash-tts, the current Gemini TTS model (google-gemini/cookbook quickstarts/Get_started_TTS.ipynb). Cases drive /v1/audio/speech (Provider.CreateSpeech), which calls generateContent with responseModalities [AUDIO].

allowed_unknown_fields.reason: known gap G12: Gemini's responseId is dropped and the canonical id is a gateway-generated gen-<nanos>, so a response cannot be traced back to Google (support cases, logs)

known gap G24: the TTS usageMetadata is decoded but thrown away (CreateSpeech returns audio only); the speech route bills input characters, while Gemini TTS is priced in tokens, audio output tokens above all
